VALIDATION_ERROR: Some of the information provided is invalid.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
OTP_TICKET_INVALID: Unable to continue. Please restart the verification.
PHONE_ALREADY_REGISTERED: Unable to continue creating this account.
PIN_TOO_WEAK: This code is too simple. Please choose a less predictable combination.
INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Unable to sign in. Please check your details.
ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Account temporarily locked after several failed attempts.
REFRESH_INVALID: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
REFRESH_REUSE_DETECTED: Unusual activity was detected. Please sign in again on all your devices.
TRANSACTION_PIN_NOT_SET: You must set a transaction code first.
INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
TONTINE_ROUND_NOT_READY: Not all members have contributed for this round yet.
TONTINE_ACCOUNT_NOT_USABLE: A tontine pot is not an account you spend from. Pick one of your own accounts.
TRANSACTION_IS_TONTINE_MOVEMENT: This entry comes from the Tontine module. Untick the matching contribution to undo it.
TRANSFER_BACKS_TONTINE: This transfer backs a tontine contribution or payout. Use the Tontine module.
ACCOUNT_NAME_TAKEN: You already have an account with this name.
ACCOUNT_IN_USE: This account already has transactions: archive it instead of deleting it.
ACCOUNT_ARCHIVED: This account is archived: it can no longer receive new transactions.
ACCOUNT_LAST_ACTIVE: You must keep at least one active account.
TRANSFER_BACKS_SAVINGS: This transfer backs a savings movement. Use “Withdraw” in the Savings module.
SAVINGS_EXCEEDS_ACCOUNT: This account does not hold enough money to set that amount aside.
SAVINGS_GOAL_ACCOUNT_MISSING: This goal is not linked to an account. Pick one before contributing.
SAVINGS_WITHDRAWAL_TOO_LARGE: You cannot withdraw more than this goal holds.
TRANSACTION_LINKED_TO_TRANSFER: This fee belongs to a transfer: edit or delete the transfer instead.
TRANSACTION_IS_FEE: This fee belongs to a transaction: edit or delete the transaction instead.
PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED: You have reached your plan's limit. Upgrade to add more.
PLAN_FEATURE_REQUIRED: This feature is not included in your plan.
PLAN_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: You have used your monthly quota. It resets on the 1st of next month.
otp_sent: A verification code has been sent if this number can receive SMS.
new_device_notification: New sign-in detected on your POOSSER account.
